text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer came to an end. A harsh, grueling summer.
And each of the Umamusume
reflected on what they had achieved.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeeek?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Doto?
Look at how much bigger and grander I've become!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You are amazing, Opera O-san... I'm not even close...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you're improving too.
Even if it's small, any progress is valuable.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Top Road-san, Ayabe-san,
the time is almost here! Can you hear it?
The sound of leaves turning color as autumn approaches.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
Thanks to you, I feel so much better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
My physical form is back, and I feel like
the scale of my running has leveled up a notch too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was pretty rough at the start of the camp,
but somehow, we managed to pull it all together.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, there was one unexpected discovery.
choice_data_list: Maybe you're suited for long distances.
Maybe you're suited for long distances, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, long distance?
Me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the looks of her training,
she seemed exceptionally suited for it.
There are plenty of promising factors, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The problem is how much our rivals have grown.
Just how far will Admire Vega and
TM Opera O go...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Top Road-san... Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Ayabe-san...?
Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To wrap up the camp, I want you to be my opponent.
In a mock race, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You are more than welcome, of course...
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The purpose is... to test my strength.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
—“Parting ways.”
With you, Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Top Road & Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
Taaaaaaahhh--!!
Haaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Their strength was almost completely equal.
Just like Narita Top Road, Admire Vega had grown too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And in the end, by just a fraction...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngggggh...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Great job, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "It's frustrating... In the very final moments, I was just barely edged out."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand, Top Road-san?
The reason behind this tiny margin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: By reason... you mean ability, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
No. Our abilities haven't changed.
Mine, yours, or Opera O's.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The slight difference isn't in our ability, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —A “distortion”.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A distortion...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega's expression as she says that is stern... and seemed a little sad.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, distortions are—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A warped thing she pours into racing. An obsession... something almost pathological.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera is conceited, and I am willing to throw everything away if it means winning.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because I have this, I can aim to be the strongest.
If I were to lose it, on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I won't be able to beat you anymore.
Not if it becomes a pure contest of raw ability."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So please, don't get in my way.
You are right. You are... so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: “Yet, some things vanish the moment you touch them. Slipping out of reach...”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Looking at it the other way... as long as this distortion remains, I won't lose the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I intend to dedicate myself—to my own path.
That is why...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Leave me alone.
In the end... we'll never understand each other.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san... Wait! Please, wait!
That's just... so wrong!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
To think the deciding factor in a race
is throwing everything away just to win...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Still... in reality, you couldn't win just now, could you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
This gap won't close.
I won't let it close.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You're the one person who shouldn't come 'over here.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Leaving those words behind, Admire Vega walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road simply gazed at that retreating figure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—on the bus back to Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Is it just like Ayabe-san said?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is simply chasing a dream not enough...?
Can I really not win just by wanting to live up to everyone's expectations?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's true, though...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right... But still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
That expression on Ayabe-san's face...
I just didn't have anything in me to definitively say she was wrong...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With this summer camp, my body has completely recovered. All that's left is—mentally preparing for the main event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cocky Opera King and the desperate shooting star.
I need to mentally prepare myself to stand against
the two of them.
